seoul.name: Seoul
seoul.rules_by: Ministry of Environment guide, Seoul Metropolitan Government

figure.what: of the household waste generated was recycled
figure.more: 2,033,960 of 3,177,620 t. The notice does not define "recycled" any further.
figure.counts: Recycled share of all household waste generated
figure.by: Seoul Metropolitan Government, notice of 2 Nov 2023
figure.quote: 생활폐기물은 총 발생량 3,177,620톤 중 재활용률은 64%에 불과한 2,033,960톤

street.basis: 2,033,960 of 3,177,620 t of household waste, as the city's notice counts it.

cup.quote: 내용물을 비우고 물로 헹구는 등 이물질을 제거하여 배출
cup.quote_en: Empty it and rinse off residue. The guide lists paper cups (종이컵) under paper (종이류), and its FAQ (p.21) adds: best collected on their own and put out with paper.

lining.quote: (bonded to the cup; goes with it)

sleeve.source: MoE sorting guide p.28 (골판지, corrugated board)
sleeve.quote_en: Put out as paper. Nearest listed item: corrugated board.

lid.source: MoE sorting guide p.33 (캡, plastic cap/lid)
lid.quote_en: Put out as plastic. Nearest listed item: plastic caps and lids (캡).

stirrer.source: MoE sorting guide p.28 (나무젓가락, wooden chopsticks)
stirrer.quote_en: Pay-as-you-throw bag. Nearest listed item: wooden chopsticks.

bottle.quote: 내용물은 비우고 라벨을 제거한 후, 찌그러트려 뚜껑을 닫아 일반 플라스틱과 구분하여 배출
bottle.quote_en: Empty it, take the label off, crush it, close the cap, and keep it apart from other plastics.

cap.quote_en: Crush it and close the cap: the cap stays on the bottle.

also.quote: 페트병 라벨, 뚜껑은 가급적 분리해서 별도 배출합니다.
also.quote_en: Take labels and caps off PET bottles where you can and put them out separately. The guide's item list sends plastic caps (캡) to plastic (p.33).

ring.quote: (stays on the neck; goes with the bottle)

label.source: MoE sorting guide p.14 (비닐류, plastic film)
label.quote_en: Film items count as plastic film even without a recycling mark. The guide says to take the label off but not where it goes; plastic film is the nearest rule.

lid.source: MoE sorting guide p.28 (골판지, corrugated board)
lid.quote_en: Put out as paper. The guide's pizza-box entry only covers the oily inner paper; nearest rule for the clean lid: corrugated board.

base.quote: 기름에 오염된 내부 종이는 종량제봉투로 배출
base.source: MoE sorting guide p.33 (피자박스, pizza box)
base.quote_en: Oil-stained inner paper goes in the pay-as-you-throw bag. The guide speaks of the inner paper, not the greasy board itself; this is the nearest rule.

crust.source: MoE sorting guide p.30 (상한 음식, spoiled food)
crust.quote_en: Put out as food waste. Nearest listed item: spoiled food.

frame.source: MoE sorting guide p.34 (휴대전화, mobile phone)
frame.quote_en: Waste electronics. Post-office trade-in is also available.

battery.quote_en: Put the phone battery out together with the phone.

glass.quote: (part of the phone; goes with it)

works.head: No way to pass it on is named
works.say: The city's pages name no reuse channel. "Donating" a phone here means donating its metal: the phone is shredded and part of the proceeds goes to charity. The national guide adds that a post-office trade-in is available.
works.quote: 폐휴대폰 기부하면 일자리도 생기고 장학금도 쌓여요.
works.quote_en: Donate an old phone and jobs and scholarships add up.
works.source: Seoul Metropolitan Government, 폐금속자원 재활용 참여 (page dated 2023-10-31)

done.head: Phone collection box
done.say: Boxes stand at subway ticket gates, community service centres, large public buildings and post offices. The 25 district offices empty them once a week.
done.quote: (지하철역 개찰구, 동주민센터, 대규모 관공서 건물, 전국 우체국 등에 비치되어 있습니다.)
done.quote_en: Boxes are placed at subway ticket gates, community service centres, large public buildings and post offices nationwide.
done.source: Seoul Metropolitan Government, 폐금속자원 재활용 참여 (page dated 2023-10-31)

next.say: Taken to the SR Center, the city's metal-recovery plant, shredded whole and mined for metals. Part of the proceeds goes to the Seoul Community Chest and the Seoul Scholarship Foundation.
next.quote: 회수한 폐휴대폰은 서울도시금속회수센터(SR센터)로 옮겨져 개인정보가 유출되지 않도록 전량 파쇄한 후 유가 금속을 추출해 자원화 합니다.
next.source: Seoul Metropolitan Government, 폐금속자원 재활용 참여

data.say: The plant shreds every phone so that no personal data gets out.

count.say: 1.938 million phones collected from 2009 to February 2026.
count.source: Seoul Metropolitan Government, 폐금속자원재활용 사업이란? (page dated 2026-03-09)

berlin.name: Berlin
berlin.rules_by: BSR (city cleaning service), Berlin district offices

figure.what: of the waste from households and small businesses went to material recycling
figure.more: 436,426 of 1,419,994 t. Burning for energy and other recovery are counted apart: 64.1 %.
figure.counts: Material recycling only; energy recovery is counted apart
figure.quote: Dies entspricht einer Recyclingquote von rund 30,7 %.

street.basis: Table 1 of the waste balance: 30.7 % material recycling, 64.1 % energy and other recovery, 0.5 % disposal, 4.6 % water loss.

cup.quote: In die Wertstofftonne können neben Leichtverpackungen (aus Kunststoff, Metall und Verbundstoff) auch sonstige kleinteilige Abfälle aus Kunststoff, Metall und Verbundmaterialien entsorgt werden.
cup.quote_en: Coffee-to-go cups are listed as packaging for the Wertstofftonne (yellow).

lining.quote: (bonded to the cup; goes with it)

sleeve.source: BSR Abfall-ABC: Pappe (no entry for cup sleeves)
sleeve.quote_en: Tear up cardboard (Papier-Tonne). Sleeves are not listed; nearest entry: Pappe.

lid.quote: In die Wertstofftonne können neben Leichtverpackungen (aus Kunststoff, Metall und Verbundstoff) auch sonstige kleinteilige Abfälle aus Kunststoff, Metall und Verbundmaterialien entsorgt werden.

stirrer.quote: Alle festen Siedlungsabfälle die übrig bleiben, nachdem Biogut, Papier und Pappe, Glas- und sonstige Verpackungen sowie Wertstoffe getrennt gesammelt wurden, werden als Hausmüll bezeichnet.
stirrer.source: BSR Abfall-ABC: Einwegbesteck (Holz) (no entry for stirrers)
stirrer.quote_en: Nearest entry: wooden disposable cutlery, listed as household waste (Restabfall).

bottle.quote: Sie können sie in jeder Verkaufsstelle zurückgeben, die Einweggebinde aus dem gleichen Material verkauft.
bottle.source: Verbraucherzentrale NRW, Einwegpfand FAQ (Stand 2026-04-21). Current law: § 46(2) VerpackDG of 13.7.2026
bottle.quote_en: You can return them at any shop that sells single-use containers of the same material. The take-back duty is now in § 46(2) VerpackDG (shops under 200 m²: only brands they sell). BSR lists only bottles without a deposit for the Wertstofftonne.

cap.quote: caps and lids remain attached to the containers during the products’ intended use stage
cap.quote_en: Caps on single-use drink bottles are tethered, so the cap goes back with the bottle.

ring.quote: (stays on the neck; goes with the bottle)

label.quote: Fehlen allerdings Pfandzeichen und Strichcode, wird es schwierig, die Verpackung als pfandpflichtig zu identifizieren.
label.quote_en: Without the deposit logo and barcode the bottle is hard to identify as a deposit bottle: the label stays on.

lid.quote: Kartons und Pappen grundsätzlich zerreißen, um das Volumen der Papiertonne optimal auszunutzen.
lid.quote_en: Pizza boxes: Papier-Tonne. Tear them up.

base.quote: Achtung: Keine stark verschmutzten Pappen (auch keine stark verschmutzte Lebensmittelverpackungen, Pizzakartons und Menüpappen) in die Papiertonne werfen.
base.quote_en: Heavily soiled pizza boxes must not go in the paper bin. BSR does not name the bin; the same paragraph sends hygiene and coated papers to Restabfall.

crust.quote_en: Pizza leftovers go in the Biogut bin.

frame.quote: Aufgrund des Schadstoffgehaltes dürfen Elektrogeräte keinesfalls über die Hausmülltonne entsorgt werden.
frame.quote_en: Because of their pollutants, electrical devices must never go in household waste. Bring small devices like phones to a Recyclinghof (free).

battery.quote: Bitte auch alle Kleingeräte wie Handys, Spielkonsolen, Toaster, Föhne, etc. zum Recyclinghof bringen.
battery.quote_en: Bring small devices like phones to a Recyclinghof. BSR does not say whether to take a built-in battery out.

glass.quote: (part of the phone; goes with it)

works.head: Pass it on
works.say: Berlin's advice for any working device: give it away through BSR's online Verschenkmarkt, or hand it in for NochMall, BSR's second-hand store.
places: Re-use drop-off for NochMall at 3 of the 14 Recyclinghöfe: Gradestraße 73, Lengeder Straße 6–18, Hegauer Weg 17
works.quote: Verschenken oder spenden Sie Ihre Geräte z.B. online über Kleinanzeigen oder den www.bsr.de/verschenkmarkt
works.quote_en: Give away or donate your devices, for example online through classified ads or www.bsr.de/verschenkmarkt.

done.head: Any Recyclinghof, free
done.say: Each of BSR's 14 Recyclinghöfe takes up to 20 old devices free of charge. Shops with more than 400 m² of sales area take old devices back as well.
done.quote: Hier können Sie bis zu 20 Elektroaltgeräte kostenfrei abgeben
done.quote_en: You can hand in up to 20 old electrical devices here free of charge.

next.say: Not stated in the pages read.

data.say: Not mentioned in the pages read.

figure.what: recovery rate reported by Recology, the city's collection company
figure.more: 392,385 tons went to landfill in rate year 2025. The city's rates office notes that the method behind the recovery rate has changed over time.
figure.counts: The collection company's recovery rate; the method has changed over time
figure.by: Recology slides, Refuse Rate Board hearing of 13 Mar 2026
figure.quote: Methodology for calculating recovery rate has changed over time.

street.what: recovered, by the collection company's rate
street.basis: Recology's recovery rate for 2025; the method behind it has changed over time.

cup.quote: Empty paper coffee cups, paper sleeves (plastic lids OK)

lining.quote: (bonded to the cup; goes with it)

sleeve.quote: Empty paper coffee cups, paper sleeves (plastic lids OK)

lid.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where

stirrer.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where (compost)

bottle.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where

cap.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where
cap.quote_en: The cap stays on the bottle.

ring.quote: (stays on the neck; goes with the bottle)
ring.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where

label.source: Labels are not named in the sources read

lid.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where (recycling)
lid.quote_en: Pizza boxes are listed only when greasy; a clean lid is nearest to non-waxed cardboard.

base.quote: Greasy pizza boxes and paper bags
base.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where (compost)

crust.source: Recology San Francisco, What Goes Where (compost)

frame.quote: Electronic Wastes includes computers, monitors, peripherals, phones, TVs
frame.source: Recology San Francisco, Universal & Electronic Waste
frame.quote_en: Phones count as electronic waste. "Drop off electronic waste at the SF Transfer Station."

battery.quote: Do not attempt to remove batteries from devices.
battery.quote_en: Leave the battery in the phone and hand the phone in. "Don't put in any bin."

board.source: Recology San Francisco, Universal & Electronic Waste

glass.quote: (part of the phone; goes with it)
glass.source: Recology San Francisco, Universal & Electronic Waste

works.head: Donate it
works.say: SF Environment's donation page names Goodwill for electronics, working or broken. Goodwill says it destroys the data before it resells or recycles a device.
works.quote: We destroy the data on all electronics before reselling, e-recycling, or disposing of as e-waste.

data.say: Goodwill says it destroys the data on every device it takes in.

done.head: Never in a bin
done.say: Drop it in one of eight Redwood Materials battery bins, with no preparation, or take it to Best Buy or the Recology transfer station.
places: Cole Hardware: 956 Cole St, 70 4th St, 627 Vallejo St, 2254 Polk St
Sports Basement: 610 Old Mason St, 3251 20th Ave, 1590 Bryant St
done.quote: Batteries and battery-embedded products cannot be discarded in recycling, compost, or landfill bins.
done.source: SF Environment, press release on public battery drop bins

next.say: Not stated in the pages read.

data.short: Goodwill, if donated; otherwise not mentioned
data.say: Not mentioned in the city pages read.

figure.what: of waste collected by the ward, per resident per day
figure.more: 64,703 t of waste collected and 19,882 t of resources recovered. The ward's targets are set in grams per resident, not as a rate.
figure.counts: Ward-collected waste ÷ residents on 1 January ÷ 365 days
figure.by: Shinjuku City, waste and resource collection table
figure.quote: 区民一人１日当たりのごみ量＝区収集ごみ量の計÷１月１日の人口÷365日

street.computed: Worked out by Teardown: 19,882 t of resources ÷ (64,703 t of waste + 19,882 t of resources), the ward's own formula for 資源化率 from its 2013 plan. The ward prints no rate for fiscal 2024.
street.basis: 19,882 t of resources and 64,703 t of waste collected by the ward in fiscal 2024.

bins.name: Resource plastic (資源プラスチック)

cup.quote: 貝殻、卵の殻、魚の骨、紙コップ、ちり紙…
cup.source: Shinjuku City, 燃やすごみの出し方 (updated 2026-04-03)
cup.quote_en: Shells, eggshells, fish bones, paper cups, tissues… are burnable.

lining.quote: (bonded to the cup; goes with it)
lining.source: Shinjuku City, 燃やすごみの出し方

sleeve.source: Not named in the sources read

lid.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方 (resource plastic examples)
lid.quote_en: Lids and fasteners (listed under resource plastic).

stirrer.source: Not named in the sources read

bottle.quote: ペットボトル / ・飲料・食品用 / ・化粧品用 / ・飲み薬用 / 水で軽くすすいでください
bottle.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方
bottle.quote_en: PET bottles (drinks, food, cosmetics, medicine): rinse lightly. Collected weekly as a resource.

cap.quote: プラスチック製のキャップは資源プラスチックへ
cap.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方
cap.quote_en: Plastic caps go to resource plastic.

ring.quote: (stays on the neck; goes with the bottle)
ring.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方

label.quote: キャップとラベルは資源プラスチックへ
label.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方
label.quote_en: Caps and labels go to resource plastic.

lid.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方 (古紙)
lid.quote_en: Cardboard is listed under used paper. Pizza boxes are not named.

base.quote: 汚れがとれないものは燃やすごみへお出しください。
base.source: Shinjuku City, 資源・ごみの分け方と出し方 (古紙)
base.quote_en: Paper whose dirt will not come off goes to burnable. A general rule, not a pizza-box ruling.

crust.source: Shinjuku City, 燃やすごみの出し方 (updated 2026-04-03)
crust.quote_en: Food scraps are burnable. Drain them first.

frame.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方 (updated 2019-04-01)
frame.quote_en: Mobile phones go in the ward's small-electronics collection boxes. Carrier shops also take them free.

battery.quote: 取り外しが可能な電池、バッテリー等はあらかじめ外してお持ちください。
battery.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方
battery.quote_en: Remove batteries only if they are removable. A built-in phone battery stays in.

board.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

glass.quote: (part of the phone; goes with it)
glass.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

works.head: No way to pass it on is named
works.say: The ward's pages name no reuse or donation channel for a phone that still works. They describe collection only.
works.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

done.head: Collection box or counter
done.say: 12 collection boxes (the ward office, 10 branch offices and Eco Gallery Shinjuku) and 7 staffed counters. Carrier shops take phones free as well.
done.quote: 携帯電話・ＰＨＳは、携帯電話事業者のショップ等でも無料で回収しています。
done.quote_en: Mobile phones are also collected free of charge at carrier shops.
done.source: Shinjuku City, 資源回収ボックス設置場所 (updated 2025-04-01)
done.source2: 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

next.say: Handed to operators certified by the national government and turned back into resources.
next.quote: 回収した使用済小型電子機器等は、国の認定を受けた「認定事業者」に引き渡して適正に資源化しています。
next.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

data.short: You do, before handing it in
data.say: You do. The ward makes the person handing it in responsible for erasing personal data.
data.quote: 小型電子機器の個人情報は、排出者が責任を持って消去してください。
data.source: Shinjuku City, 使用済小型電子機器等の出し方

count.say: 268 t of used small electronics collected in fiscal 2024.
count.quote: 使用済小型電子機器等
